publication: DOE/Compressed Air Challenge third edition; PDF metadata2016,114pages. Live official URL verified2026-11-02; not presented as a new2026design standard.
primary_summary: The guide separates centrifugal compressed-air controls from rotary controls. Blow-off/recycle is discussed in relation to surge protection. Baselines combine power, pressure and flow with production and operating-condition context. Logged direct real power has a different basis from a rough electrical estimate. Assessment duration depends on demand variation. The guide is introductory rather than a comprehensive design text.

bounded_collection_criteria.basis: authored scope policy, supported by L1-L3
bounded_collection_criteria.expected: State or request machine class, service and operating duty before applying a centrifugal-air interpretation. A generic compressor/recycle label remains a candidate, not evidence of unnecessary flow.
bounded_collection_criteria.unacceptable: Treat all process-gas, rotary, unknown or generic compressors as proven instances of the cited centrifugal-air control example.
bounded_collection_criteria.interpretation: Primary locators support the stated engineering context only; the paired software/collection criterion is an authored inference.

bounded_collection_criteria.basis: authored identity/association control; engineering inference, not a DOE schema
bounded_collection_criteria.expected: Keep exact compressor, valve and record identities and source/revision/locator qualifiers visible. A unit/area association or target claim is a review candidate. Explicit foreign/unknown pairing must remain unresolved.
bounded_collection_criteria.unacceptable: Convert same_unit, similar labels, or one sibling record into verified installed pairing or coverage for another compressor.
bounded_collection_criteria.interpretation: Authored association/software/receiving policy; not a literal DOE requirement or prescribed data schema.

bounded_collection_criteria.basis: authored quantity-separation control supported by L4; not a quoted valve-calibration rule
bounded_collection_criteria.expected: Distinguish controller demand/output, actual travel/position and measured flow. Preserve provided quantity/unit/quality/reference conditions and missing alternatives.
bounded_collection_criteria.unacceptable: Infer actual valve travel from a command, recycle flow from percent opening, or zero/unknown flow from a missing field.
bounded_collection_criteria.interpretation: Primary locators support the stated engineering context only; the paired software/collection criterion is an authored inference.

bounded_collection_criteria.basis: authored records-first workflow supported by L4-L5
bounded_collection_criteria.expected: Start with existing approved/supplied records and their suitability, time alignment, operating-mode coverage and limitations. Suitable existing evidence may be acknowledged; gaps stay explicit.
bounded_collection_criteria.unacceptable: Require a new month of export, walkdown or test when suitable records already exist, or treat any filled label/spot sample as sufficient regardless of declared coverage.
bounded_collection_criteria.interpretation: Primary locators support the stated engineering context only; the paired software/collection criterion is an authored inference.

bounded_collection_criteria.basis: authored representative-period criterion supported by L4-L5
bounded_collection_criteria.expected: Separate normal, part-load/turndown, startup/shutdown and upset context when supplied and relevant. Select the review period from the stated duty/demand basis rather than a universal duration.
bounded_collection_criteria.unacceptable: Automatically close the investigation solely because a valve opens during turndown/upsets, or because a fixed month is present/absent.
bounded_collection_criteria.interpretation: Primary locators support the stated engineering context only; the paired software/collection criterion is an authored inference.

bounded_collection_criteria.basis: authored machine-protection inference supported by L2-L3, not a source-prescribed universal margin test
bounded_collection_criteria.expected: Review the appropriate current manufacturer/site protection basis, conditions and revision with responsible expertise when applicable. Existing records can be retained without declaring settings inadequate.
bounded_collection_criteria.unacceptable: Declare controller margin excessive from one generic map or percentage, mandate a smaller margin, operate a valve, induce surge, or change protection/settings through this screen.
bounded_collection_criteria.interpretation: Primary locators support the stated engineering context only; the paired software/collection criterion is an authored inference.

bounded_collection_criteria.basis: authored energy-evidence inference supported by L4

bounded_collection_criteria.unacceptable: Treat nameplate power, one unmatched meter, or one sibling trace as complete representative real-power evidence for every anchor.
bounded_collection_criteria.interpretation: Primary locators support the stated engineering context only; the paired software/collection criterion is an authored inference.
